doc.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: His brother and sister did not become musicians
summary: His brother played piano and sax but became a painter-minded person; only he and his father were professional musicians.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You mentioned that your brother learned to play piano; did your other brother play as

He used to play the piano and then he learned to play the saxophone. He was never a musician in his heart; he never wanted to be a musician. And I don’t blame him. [Both laugh] No he developed some other things. He liked painting. that type of thing.
So neither of your brothers became professional musicians?
No, Rosalito, he’s a painter, a very talented painter and designer.
And how old is your sister?
My sister is now 50, and my brother is 60 already, probably 59 or 60.
You and your father were the only musicians in the family?
Yea; professional musicians, only him and me.
